chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl ibn Darrāj, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Touching the dead person at the time of his death and after his ghusl, and kissing him, there is no harm in it.
ai.seo_question: Is there any problem in touching or kissing a deceased person at the time of death or after ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that there is no harm in touching the deceased at the time of death, after the deceased has been given ghusl, and in kissing the deceased. It relates to rulings of ritual purity and conduct concerning the dead in Shia fiqh.
